auth_details: API key via Authorization: Apikey YOUR_API_KEY or query api_key=; active CoinDesk Data API subscription/plan required (key alone insufficient after free-tier retirement May 21, 2026)
free_tier_limits: Free API tier retired May 21, 2026; no recurring free quota. Pricing still lists Personal (FREE, non-commercial) with capped lifetime calls (docs default lifetime 250,000).
paid_plans: Start-Up: contact sales / preferential early-stage pricing; Enterprise: contact/bespoke. Personal shown FREE with lifetime call cap. See developers.coindesk.com/pricing.
resolution_notes: name: auditor right—CCData→CoinDesk Data (https://data.coindesk.com/press-releases/coindesk-unveils-strategic-rebrand-of-ccdata-to-coindesk-data); min-api.cryptocompare.com still legacy Min API under CoinDesk (developers.coindesk.com). pricing: auditor right—free tier retired 2026-05-21 (https://data.coindesk.com/blogs/changes-to-coindesk-data-indices-api-free-tier-access); Personal FREE + lifetime caps; Start-Up/Enterprise contact (https://developers.coindesk.com/pricing/). auth: auditor right—subscription required; live min-api 401 without entitled key.
